name: Succubi Don't Do Housework
source:
Succubi Don't Do Housework is a visual novel originally intended for NanoReno 2017! Follow the grumpy programmer Reien, who after years and years of searching, has finally found her lover from her past life. It's too bad that said lover just so happens to be a succubus with no memories the past though! Help her remember (or don't!) in this short romantic comedy featuring four different endings!

[From [url=https://mabsart.itch.io/sddhw]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《魅魔不做家务》原本是为NanoReno2017制作的视觉小说！跟随脾气暴躁的程序员Reien，她经过多年寻找，终于找到了前世的恋人。遗憾的是，那位恋人恰好是一名失去过去记忆的魅魔！帮助她恢复记忆（也可以选择不帮），体验这部拥有四种不同结局的短篇浪漫喜剧！

[来源：[url=https://mabsart.itch.io/sddhw]itch.io[/url]]
